overall.why: AI AutoPosing/Physics + AI Root Motion,UE Live Link
overall.why_en: AI AutoPosing/Physics + AI Root Motion; UE Live Link

overall.name: Anything World — Animate Anything
overall.why: 任意靜態網格 AI 綁定(尤其動物/生物)
overall.why_en: AI-rig any static mesh (esp. animals/creatures)

items.name: Tripo AI Rigging v3.0 & Retargeting Upgrade
items.why: 此更新顯著提升了人形模型的綁骨速度和品質，並擴展了綁骨類型，同時改進了重定向功能，使其在遊戲模組化中更高效。
items.why_en: This update significantly improves rigging speed and quality for humanoid models, expands rig types, and enhances retargeting, making it more efficient for game modding.

items.name: Cascadeur 2026.2.3
items.why: 作為專用動畫和綁骨工具的最新版本，它延續了2026.2版本在AutoPosing、物理和AI工具方面的改進，提供更精確的綁骨控制。
items.why_en: As the latest version of a dedicated animation and rigging tool, it continues the improvements from version 2026.2 in AutoPosing, physics, and AI tools, offering more precise rigging control.

items.name: Mesh2Motion (重大更新)
items.why: 本次重大更新帶來了改進的綁骨工具、自定義綁骨重定向、FBX導出和離線支持，對於遊戲模組開發者而言是重要的功能提升。
items.why_en: This major update brings improved rigging tools, custom rig retargeting, FBX export, and offline support, representing significant functional enhancements for game mod developers.

items.name: Meshy Edit
items.why: 儘管不是直接的綁骨工具，但其局部編輯3D模型的能力對於在綁骨前後精修AI生成模型至關重要，尤其適用於遊戲模組化。
items.why_en: Although not a direct rigging tool, its ability to locally edit 3D models is crucial for refining AI-generated models before or after rigging, especially for game modding.

items.name: Animatica Marionette
items.why: 這是一個新發佈的Blender插件，專為擺放現有的人形變形骨架而設計，為Blender用戶提供了新的綁骨工作流程選項。
items.why_en: This newly released Blender add-on is designed for posing existing humanoid deform skeletons, offering new rigging workflow options for Blender users.
